Several chocolate chips appear to float slightly above the surface or merge indistinctly into the ice cream without clear displacement or shadowing, suggesting minor physics simulation errors.
The elliptical perspective of the ramekin rim is slightly inconsistent with the plate's curvature, appearing slightly warped rather than a perfect geometric ellipse.
